protocol.hypothesis: Changing only eligible-candidate ordering to signed BTC-relative7day return per asset daily ATR may select more productive exposure.

ranking.return_definition: r_asset=P_asset(S)/P_asset(S-7d)-1; r_btc=P_BTC(S)/P_BTC(S-7d)-1; P(S) is the close of H1 ending exactly at signal boundary S.
ranking.direction: sign remains sign(r_asset), and existing BTC7_SIGN gate remains mandatory; no relative-return sign gate.
ranking.ordering: Descending score among original eligible candidates; then ascending entry_fee/planned_risk, then symbol. Negative scores remain eligible. BTC itself remains eligible with relative score0. No new threshold or exclusion.
ranking.causality: At execution opening T use signal_at S=T-3600; returns and daily ATR use closed bars ending<=S. Neither delay bar nor execution bar can affect rank.
ranking.normalization: Exactly the ATR14 daily from the existing entry event, not a newly estimated volatility or regression beta.

unchanged: fixed1% risk inclusive modeled stop loss costs/funding reserve
initial stop and daily trailing update

evaluation.baseline: Exact full-wallet equality for all8 prior fixed1% wallets required, including curves and trades.
evaluation.acceptance: Exploratory screen: continuous base and stress ROI must both strictly improve; continuous base maximum H1 drawdown<=10%; each of3 separate periods must be positive in both cost scenarios; no modeled liquidation or new unresolved liquidation ambiguity. Original temporal consistency screen also retained separately.
evaluation.search: Exactly one candidate/formula; no parameter, side, symbol, period or threshold pruning after inspecting outcomes. All negative results retained.

limitations: All past data examined during strategy development; no independent holdout
Current universe and catalog create survivor/metadata bias
Simulated fills and approximate liquidation; H1 marked drawdown
